messages:
alex: Heads-up: planning NIC firmware upgrade + BGP config push that will touch egress paths in us-west2 and apac-west1. Window proposed: Thu 03:00–05:00 UTC. We'll do rolling node reboots + kube drain for GPU pools. Expect a short spike in queue/backfill (~10–15%). Need ops signoff and a backfill plan.

maria: Can we shift earlier to 02:00–04:00 UTC? Traffic profile looks slightly lower in us-west then. Also need exact pool names and GPU counts.

alex: We could shift but that pushes into APAC maintenance hours. Affected pools: gpu-pool-usw2-standard (120 GPUs), gpu-pool-apac-west1-spot (48 GPUs). Rotation target: ~20 nodes/hr. Plan to preheat KV cache after each node group to reduce cold-start token latency.

jordan: FYI apac pool is mostly preemptible. If we cordon too many at once we risk capacity evaporation. Recommend slowing drain cadence for apac and enable reserved fallback routing for that region.

ops-oncall: @alex @maria schedule looks tolerable from ops side. I'll run the preflight checklist. Please add a canary cohort (2 nodes) and telemetry gates: pod eviction rate, p95 latency, and egress packet drop.

kai: Network note: BGP push will flip local egress AS path briefly (~30–90s). Add a 10m buffer after the BGP change for monitoring and avoid escalating to bulk until canary is green. Also run a quick jitter test during canary: `iperf3 -c 10.0.1.2 -t 30`.

sre-bot: capacity_check: predicted_available=130 GPUs; predicted_spill=12%; suggested_backfill=20 GPUs from reserved pools.

maria: Cost ask: if we backfill with reserved, what's the delta for the maintenance window? Jordan?

jordan: Backfill est: 20 reserved GPUs x $0.65/hr x ~2hr ~= $26. With churn buffer round to $35. Still cheaper than potential user-facing errors or retries.

alex: Proposed runbook summary: Thu 03:00 UTC start. 03:00–03:10 canary (2 nodes). 03:10–04:40 rolling drains across cohorts (20 nodes/hr). Post-BGP buffer + validation: 04:40–05:00. I'll create the maintenance ticket and customer comms.

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: I'll own the runbook and rollback steps. Please paste the kube drain snippet for ops.

alex: Run this during each cohort: ```kubectl drain <node-name> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=10m``` then cordon after verification.

jordan: One more: enable fallback routing policy for models/endpoints for 30m to avoid request failures if capacity dips.

kai: Ack from network team. I'll hold the BGP push until canary metrics are green and give a thumbs when ready.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: maintenance_ticket=INC-5678 created; runbook_link=https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5678

maria: OK, thanks everyone — if no objections I approve the window.

alex: No objections noted. I'll schedule and loop in support for customer pages.

maria: thanks, ship it.
